h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Kolhapur

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Kolhapur

items.pText: FunPlay Systems supplies outdoor playground equipment to schools, housing societies and parks in Kolhapur. We make every piece at our factory in Vasai, about 330 km away, and bring it to Kolhapur by road. Our installation team or a local dealer then sets it up on your site, on a self-standing base or grouted into the ground.

Kolhapur buyers often ask for equipment that can take daily use by large groups. That could be a school compound, a society garden in one of the newer residential areas or a public garden run by the municipal corporation. Tell us the size of the space and the age group of the children, and we will send a layout drawing with the safe play area marked before you decide. Most projects start with a few photos of the site and a short phone call.

props.h2Text: How would you like to start?
props.pText: Turn your playground dreams to reality

c: Kolhapur gets heavy rain from June to September, and flat ground near the Panchganga river can stay wet for days. Raise the play area slightly, give it a drainage slope and lay rubber flooring under slides and swings so children do not play on mud or hard stone. Galvanised steel posts and roto-moulded plastic parts handle the wet months well, since plastic does not rust and the zinc coating protects the steel.

items.q: Do you install playground equipment in Kolhapur?
items.a: Yes. We send the equipment from our Vasai factory by road and install it with our own team or a dealer close to Kolhapur.

items.q: What is the best surface under playground equipment in a rainy area?
items.a: Rubber flooring on a slightly raised, well-drained base. It cushions falls and dries faster than soil or grass after heavy rain.

items.q: Can you suggest equipment for a small society garden?
items.a: Yes. Share the length and width of the garden and the age group. We will suggest pieces that fit and mark the safe play area on a layout drawing.
